title: A lower key can cut a subtree
hook: A lower key can force a descendant out of its parent.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Cut a decreased Fibonacci-heap node without immediately consolidating the forest.

misconception: A decreased key must rotate or sift through all ancestors.
objective: Cut a decreased Fibonacci-heap node without immediately consolidating the forest.

claims.text: A decreased child that undercuts its parent is cut into the root list. Its nonroot parent records the loss with a mark; a later child loss would trigger a cascading cut, while a decrease that preserves order needs no cut.
